$comment: Copy this file to config.json at the repository root (git-ignored) or to ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/agentic-tools/config.json. Each account needs a gh login: gh auth login, then check with gh auth status. prflow reads tokens with gh auth token -u <login> and never switches the active account.

accounts.$comment: An account can cover every repo under these owners plus selected repos elsewhere. A repos entry wins over another account's owners entry.
An account with no owners or repos covers every repo not claimed above. At most one account may be unscoped.

rails.$comment: prflow.rails: optional tick limits. Missing keys keep their defaults (shown here).

actions.$comment: prflow.actions.dryRun: tick actions (rerun cancelled CI, archive clean worktrees) are announced only while true. Set false to act.

dispatch.$comment: prflow.dispatch.dryRun: Pi dispatch for ci, comments, and behind. Briefs and targets are announced only while true; set false to launch and message Pi sessions. Separate from prflow.actions.dryRun. A PR in prflow.dispatch.projectContext repos, or in any repo of one of its owners, gets a pointer to <path>/AGENTS.md and <path>/<folder>/AGENTS.md.

review.$comment: prflow.review.dryRun: reviewer sessions use one persistent Orca worktree per PR and save per-head drafts under the state directory. Announced only while true; set false to create worktrees and launch reviewers. Tick never posts; use prflow review post <draft-id> --yes.

repoSync.$comment: Repos (Orca display name, folder name, or owner/repo) whose pulls print their new commits and changed paths. Default [].

taskStatus.$comment: orca-task-status: Orca board status id per task state. in-progress, in-review, and done default to Orca's built-in in-progress, in-review, and completed. Custom columns (paused, blocked, needs-attention) have generated ids; read one with orca-ide worktree current --json from a worktree in that column.
